Line Dance Lessons

Line Dance Lessons at LostWeekend 👯‍♀️ Ready to learn the moves? Join us from 6:30–8:00pm for dedicated line dance lessons in a fun, welcoming atmosphere. Whether you’re completely new to line dancing or looking to build on the basics, our instructor will guide you step-by-step through the dances, helping you gain confidence and have a great time on the floor, catering to all levels. These classes are standalone sessions — perfect for anyone who wants to improve their skills, get moving, or learn more dances for our CMN parties. 15€ per person. Grab your boots and come dance with us! 👢

Kiwi Comedy • Fitz Gessler

Fitz Gessler is heading out on his first German tour; bringing his laid-back, sharp take on life in Germany to the stage. Originally from New Zealand 🇳🇿 with German parents 🇩🇪 and now based in Berlin, Fitz has become a familiar face across Europe’s comedy scene, performing everywhere from small clubs to theaters. His mix of Kiwi and German gives a unique perspective rarely seen. You might recognise him from his stand-up clips online (with millions of views 👀), where he shares funny, honest observations about German culture, dating, and family life. Open Stage

HOW TO SIGN UP Sign-up Window: 19:15 – 19:45 (before the music starts). Process: Write your name and your Instagram handle on a slip of paper and drop it in the box. Everyone who plays gets tagged. Selection: 20 slots per night. Performance order is drawn from the box completely at random. YOUR SLOT Format: 1 Slot = 2 songs, up to 10 minutes maximum. Timing: Your time starts as soon as your name is called (setup included). Wrap it up when the host gives you the sign—anything past 10 minutes cuts into someone else’s time. Line Dancing

An evening to enjoy the increasingly popular country lifestyle. Bust out your boots and hats (if you like) and enjoy an evening of hot new country hits and classics. Feel free to join in on some line dancing – instructors will be introducing at least one new dance per night and are available to help anyone out! Or just be entertained by the music and atmosphere amongst other like minded fans of country music with some great food and drinks. Doors @ 19:00
